title: Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh meets Prime Minister
body_text:
Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh met Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi today in New Delhi.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X;
“Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh, @DrMohanYadav51 met Prime Minister @narendramodi.
@CMMadhyaPradesh”
Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh, @DrMohanYadav51 met Prime Minister @narendramodi . @CMMadhyaPradesh pic.twitter.com/prpfwzqy6d — PMO India (@PMOIndia) October 1, 2026
